status: PROPOSAL (W2 PWRJ-F2C probe, never merged): board-side contract of the F2-C front-slab board PWR-C; not generated by mechanical/build.py
why: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json has no PWR_C entry. pcb/board_gen.py and pcb/check_boards.py read the contract named in pcb/boards/PWR_C.json, so this file stands in (as build/kicad/boards/PACK_FUSE/contract-proposal.json did) until a MECH package adopts PWR_C into mechanical/params/boards.json; then the spec points there and the board is routed once more.
frame: board mm, viewed from the component side, which faces the battery tray (-z): x = 160 - enclosure x, y = enclosure y - 4; origin = enclosure (160, 4). The board back lies 0.5 mm from the front-wall inner face (board z 65.48-67.08), parts hang towards the tray down to z 58.98 (6.5 mm), 0.58 mm above the tray front face z 58.4.

sources.envelope: pwr-decision.json fallback F2-C and the PWR-C+R proposal of the SHRINK study (pwr-study.json proposals[1]): enclosure x 4-160, y 4-37.5, z 58.4-67.58, parts 6.5 mm or lower, an 18 mm hole for the V2 vent at enclosure (80, 21); judges 2 and 3 found no layout item, structure box or harness route there on wip/w2-int 4d459155
sources.corner: enclosure outer corner radius 14 and wall 2.5 (mechanical/params/mechanical.json outer): the inner-wall arc of the lower-left corner is centred at enclosure (14, 14) with radius 11.5; the 5.5 mm chamfer at board (150.5, 0)-(156, 5.5) keeps its midpoint 10.25 mm from that centre (1.25 mm clear)
sources.holes: design choice of the probe: five M3 holes on front-shell bosses like the CTRL bosses (probe 4 dropped the sixth at (91.5, 29.5): its keep-out closed the LAB5 path from XJC2 to U553); MECH places the bosses

stackup.fab: JLC04161H-7628 4-layer FR-4 1.6 mm, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner (as PWR-A, build/15 'Шари')
stackup.components: top side only (SMD and THT); THT pin tails trimmed flush (1.0 mm or less) towards the front wall, polyimide on the back

PWR_C.name: PWR-C front-slab power-entry board (F2-C): E1 battery front end, INA228 shunt monitor, Pololu #2813 switch, E5 IMU service, W-C1/W-C2 interconnect
PWR_C.outline_note: 156 x 33.5 = enclosure x 4-160, y 4-37.5, with the 5.5 mm chamfer at the lower-left inner-wall arc (board lower right in the component-side frame)
PWR_C.cutouts_note: the V2 vent passage, enclosure centre (80, 21) = board (80, 17), as an 18 x 18 mm rectangular cut-out (the recorded 18 mm hole, milled square in the probe)
PWR_C.max_component_height_note: the slab between the board face z 65.48 and the tray front face z 58.4 leaves 7.08 mm; 6.5 keeps 0.58 mm clear (F2-C record)

W-C1 to PWR-A J106/J107 (PWR-A bottom edge at enclosure y 38.5), S10/S11/S12/S32 harness exits
